name: Google Cloud Vertex AI generative inference
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model Meta Llama 3.3 70B via Vertex AI Model-as-a-Service partner-model table, observed 2026-10-14 ($0.72 in = $0.72 out, symmetric; batch $0.36/$0.36). Other MaaS rows same-day: Llama 4 Scout $0.25/$0.70, Llama 4 Maverick $0.35/$1.15, gpt-oss-120b $0.09/$0.36, gpt-oss-20b $0.07/$0.25, DeepSeek-V3.2 $0.56/$1.68, Qwen3-235B $0.22/$0.88, GLM-5 $1.00/$3.20, Mistral Medium 3 $0.40/$2.00. First-party Gemini rows are a separate table (Gemini 3.8 Flash intro $0.75/$3.75 through 2026-12-31, then $1.50/$7.50). Non-global endpoints add 10%.
notes: Two services under one endpoint family: first-party Gemini (per-model global/non-global tables, non-global +10%) and the partner-model MaaS catalog where open weights (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, gpt-oss, Mistral) are served on Google's own infrastructure with Google-set prices. Measured figures are OpenRouter's 2026-10-14 P50 on Google Vertex's llama-3.3-70b endpoint: 98 tok/s but 4.44s latency - the slowest TTFT on that table, an order of magnitude behind Groq, which is the finding that matters for latency-sensitive callers. Vertex also sells tuned-model endpoints at 1.5x base price.
